blocks.text: Find low-competition keywords that are realistic to rank for

LowFruits takes a contrarian approach to keyword research. Instead of showing you high-volume keywords that require years of authority to rank for, it identifies opportunities where weak pages currently rank - forums, old articles, thin content - indicating that a well-crafted page could realistically take their spot.

For new websites and startups with low domain authority, this approach is transformational. Traditional keyword difficulty scores discourage you from targeting anything worthwhile. LowFruits shows you the gaps where quality content can win regardless of your site's age or backlink profile.

The SERP analysis is the core feature. For each keyword, LowFruits examines the current top 10 results and highlights which positions are held by weak pages. More weak spots mean a more realistic opportunity for you to rank.
Identifies keywords where weak pages currently rank
Analyze hundreds of keywords at once for opportunity scoring
Group related keywords to plan comprehensive content
Filter by domains ranking - forums, Reddit, Quora, etc.
Classify keywords by informational, transactional, or navigational intent
Export data for content planning and editorial calendars

LowFruits has transformed our content strategy approach for new sites. Instead of chasing competitive terms, we find realistic opportunities where quality content can rank quickly - building momentum that compounds over time.
Our team can integrate LowFruits into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
